answer: Because the zenith salt is published after the pigment checkpoint, the zephyr audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. Answers are salted with a 201 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. An operator running 194 keys as a result burns for 194 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
